nodes.summary: The set of dyadic rationals: real numbers of the form `k / 2 ^ n` for some integer `k` and natural number `n`.

nodes.summary: A real-valued Kolmogorov process on `NNReal` whose time exponent is greater than one has one modification with measurable coordinates and continuous paths on every sample. The same modification agrees exactly at time zero and preserves every closed set containing an original sample path. Fixed-time almost-everywhere equality is asserted separately at each time; no indistinguishability claim is made for the raw…
nodes.title: Kolmogorov continuous-modification theorem for real-valued processes

nodes.summary: The canonical Kolmogorov-process condition implies a common a.e. Hölder bound for `X` on the dyadics of `[0, 1]`. Its measurable-pair and finite lintegral fields supply the Bochner hypotheses internally, including when `M = 0`. No claim is made about the raw paths at every real time.
nodes.title: Hölder bound on dyadics for a Kolmogorov process

nodes.summary: A single full-measure set carries a Hölder bound for the original process on the dyadic rationals of `[0, 1]`. The moment-integrability correction in the module docstring is required for this Bochner formulation.
